text:
Sam: Quick kickoff — we need a compact "message matrix" for the benchmark webinar and the inbound routing rules. Goal: make latency vs cost story obvious in 90s, with deeper dives later.
Mira: Who are we prioritizing in the 90s hook? devs or infra buyers? different CTAs I assume.
Jon: Both. Short hook for devs (try API, demo), slightly heavier hook for infra/platform (Dedicated pricing + SLA call).
Carla: Agree. Also need to call out Private/VPC for regulated customers — that changes the cost framing.
Leo: Thinking chart set: 1) scatter: latency vs cost per token (show model variants + quantization), 2) waterfall: per-request latency contributions (network, queuing, model), 3) throughput economics: tokens/sec vs $/hour. Interactive variant for console/demo.
Sam: Nice. @Carla can you confirm which model variants & quant profiles we can publicly show? legal/privacy callouts?
Carla: We can show representative open models and our verified perf profiles. For Dedicated/Private use anonymized configs: e.g., "A100-80GB quant-8" -> "High-perf" label. No customer data.
Mira: For the webinar flow I propose: 0-90s elevator (scatter + single line), 3-5min deep dive (waterfall), 8-12min case study (throughput economics + routing), then live Q/A with routing + CTO ask.
Jon: Lead routing tags we should capture from registration and CTAs: "interest:performance", "interest:cost-savings", "interest:private-deploy". These map to SDR plays: demo, pricing + SRE call, enterprise sales.
Sam: Example micro-copy for CTAs: "Try a latency-optimized demo", "Estimate your per-request cost", "Talk to our Private deployment team". Keep them <6 words.
Carla: Quick inline copy ideas: - "See how 50ms latency reduces per-conversation cost" - "Run your workload on Dedicated GPUs — predictable pricing" - "Private deployment: on-prem & VPC options"
Leo: Chart annotations: call out batching and KV-caching effects as separate lines on scatter. Add a small callout for graceful degradation fallback to cheaper model variants.
Mira: For marketing assets: 1 hero slide (scatter), 2 explainer slides (waterfall + throughput), 3 social cards (one-liners for dev, infra, enterprise). Can design produce mockups by EOD Friday?
Sam: Design ask noted. @ops-bot can you schedule the benchmark review at 3pm Thu?
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Benchmark narrative review — Thu 15:00. Invite: #marketing, #eng-ml, #product. :bell:
Jon: One more routing detail — track CTA clicks by UTM: utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_content={performance|cost|private}. Send to SDR queue with tag mapping.
Carla: I'll assemble the anonymized perf table and share a Google sheet link in a follow-up.
Sam: Perfect. After we lock chart assets we'll draft the announcement post + webinar landing copy.
Mira: For the landing page lead form, add a free-text "primary concern" field to surface if they care about latency vs cost vs compliance. Helps SDR triage.
Sam: Love it. Final deliverables list we need: chart PNGs, explainer slide deck, CTA copy + UTM map, lead routing mapping, anonymized perf sheet. Deadline: next Wed.
Carla: On it.
Sam: :thumbsup:
